pattern.name: issue_template
pattern.description: Use the requested sections to keep drafts structured

template.issue_overview: Describe the problem, impact, and desired outcome.
template.file_context: List key files/directories that are relevant or referenced.
template.related_information: Mention follow-ups, risks, alternatives, or next steps.

pattern.name: follow_up_loop
pattern.description: Cycle until no missing details remain

loop.question: What impact does this have?
Which files are involved?
loop.answer: Note any examples or paths mentioned.
loop.question: What would success look like?
